1368:v1:8380c1413f88.title: Fix(cli): delete a word with Ctrl-Backspace
1368:v1:8380c1413f88.summary: The PR extends the word-delete handler in `MultilineInput` to treat Ctrl+Backspace the same as Alt+Backspace and Ctrl+W, since the previous condition only matched an Alt-like modifier. A test mounts the real component and asserts that pressing Ctrl+Backspace on 'hello world' removes 'world' and leaves the cursor at position 6. The preview shows the existing backspace branch being broadened and a new test block added to cover it.

1259:v1:a4f95e6efc1f.title: Fix MCP tool schema and result handling bug families
1259:v1:a4f95e6efc1f.summary: The PR proposes seven fixes across MCP tool schema handling, result mapping, and agent state representation, including serving JSON Schema tool inputs verbatim instead of zod round-tripping, keeping zod schema instances alive when cloning tool definitions, and mapping text and non-image MCP resources to json instead of media. The preview shows that text resources now flow through mcpContentToToolResultOutputs as json values, and tool definitions are stored as plain JSON Schema in agent state. Regression tests are promoted into a permanent checklist-shaped suite covering wiring, mapping, and type correctness.

1328:v1:bb5bc6f65cae.title: Reload MCP servers and skills after project change in picker
1328:v1:bb5bc6f65cae.summary: This PR addresses an issue where changing projects via the project picker in the CLI doesn't refresh the loaded MCP servers and skills, leaving stale registries from the previous project. It introduces reinitialization of the local agent registry and skill registry after a project change, ensuring that project-specific configurations like `.agents/mcp.json` and `.agents/skills/` are correctly loaded. The change includes an integration test that reproduces the bug by switching from a project without `.agents/` to one with MCP and skill definitions, validating that registries are reloaded properly.

1316:v1:177b758901fb.title: Stop CLI launcher re-downloading installed binary on every launch
1316:v1:177b758901fb.summary: The launcher in cli/release-core/launcher.js now consults a new getUpdateComparisonVersion() helper that falls back to the wrapper version when the metadata cache is missing or unreadable, so an already-installed binary that still exists on disk is no longer treated as unknown and re-downloaded on every startup. The registry URL is also made overridable via CODEBUFF_NPM_REGISTRY_URL so tests can intercept the version check instead of hitting the real npm registry. A new test suite cli/src/__tests__/release/launcher-installed-binary.test.ts covers these startup and background-update scenarios.

1308:v1:555f9dcd16e0.title: Fix stuck model switches from false end-failure in session takeover
1308:v1:555f9dcd16e0.summary: This PR refactors the model_locked takeover flow in `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts` so the deliberate-pick guard, follow-up GET, DELETE, and chat notices all live in `runModelLockedTakeover` with injected collaborators, and the new `planModelLockedSwitch` planner maps the follow-up GET row to `release`, `retry`, or `explain` outcomes. It fixes two false end-failure cases that stranded users for an hour: `ended` rows still inside the server grace window now trigger a release instead of reporting 'ending it failed, run /end-session', and rows that vanished between the lock response and follow-up GET fall through to `retry` without surfacing the missing-row notice. The preview shows a new test file `model-locked-takeover.test.ts` covering active, ended-in-grace, vanished, and ended-past-grace held-row shapes with injected `fetchHeld`/`releaseSlot`/`notify`/`isStale` collaborators.

1302:v1:b9eff978cd65.title: Enhance tests for axiom response assertion
1302:v1:b9eff978cd65.summary: The PR expands test coverage for the Axiom response assertion helper by adding cases for non-throwing complete responses, statusless and partial inputs with an end-anchored regex, and non-object inputs. It addresses three gaps flagged in the description: missing coverage for the complete (non-partial) case, missing statusless input cases, and an unanchored toThrow regex. The preview shows changes confined to common/src/util/__tests__/axiom-complete-response.test.ts.

1292:v1:85e3657e2267.title: Drop orphaned tool results at trim boundary
1292:v1:85e3657e2267.summary: The PR adds a post-trim sweep in `trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit` that removes surviving `role: 'tool'` messages whose `toolCallId` no longer appears in any retained assistant tool-call, closing the gap left by `dropUnansweredToolCalls`. The preview shows new regression tests in `messages.test.ts` covering boundary orphaning, the `keepDuringTruncation` middle case, and a keep-survival guard.

1291:v1:f4522bbee589.title: Guard whitespace-only strings from empty-match file corruption
1291:v1:f4522bbee589.summary: The PR adds a guard in `packages/agent-runtime/src/process-str-replace.ts` so that when the whitespace-insensitive fallback in `tryMatchOldStr` strips a whitespace-only `oldString` to `''`, it reports not-found instead of producing a vacuous empty match. Without this fix, `replaceAll('', newStr)` inserted the new string between every character of the file and the tool returned success with the corrupted content written to disk.

1284:v1:f3da456b874b.title: Fix NaN handling in ttft latency bucket index
1284:v1:f3da456b874b.summary: The `ttftBucketIndex` function in `common/src/util/ttft-histogram.ts` does not validate that the latency input is a finite number, so a `NaN` input propagates through `Math.max` and `Math.log` to produce a `NaN` bucket index. The preview shows the fix special-casing only `Number.isNaN` to route to bucket 0, while letting `Infinity` values flow through the normal calculation where they clamp to the top bucket.

1274:v1:f70b1a2c23c1.title: Feat(cli): scroll the transcript three lines per wheel notch
1274:v1:f70b1a2c23c1.summary: The PR proposes adding a stateless `ConstantScrollAccel` class to the Freebuff CLI so that a single mouse wheel notch scrolls the chat transcript by three lines instead of the default one line. It passes this accelerator through a new `scrollAcceleration` prop on the `<scrollbox>` in `chat.tsx`, which OpenTUI's `ScrollBoxRenderable` already supports via a setter and constructor. The change adds an integration test that drives real wheel events at a rendered scrollbox to verify the full OpenTUI event chain moves exactly three lines per notch.

1258:v1:5400107fb79b.title: Wait for current turn to finish before auto-update restart
1258:v1:5400107fb79b.summary: PR #1258 proposes a fix for issue #994 where the CLI wrapper unconditionally stops the running process during an auto-update, even if the user is mid-turn. The patch adds a cross-process activity marker written by the binary side via `cli/src/utils/run-activity-marker.ts` for the duration of a turn, and a corresponding `waitForRunIdle(pid)` polling function in `cli/release-core/launcher.js` that waits for the marker to clear before stopping the process. The preview shows `waitForRunIdle` being called in the launcher's update flow after staging the binary and before stopping the running process, with a bounded 10-minute wait and stale marker cleanup on spawn.

1256:v1:29b9b2c86b2a.title: Queue plan, interview, and review mid-turn submits instead of interrupting in-progress runs
1256:v1:29b9b2c86b2a.summary: The /plan, /interview, and /review slash commands currently bypass the busy-state check that other mid-turn submit paths use, calling sendMessage() directly and forcing registerActiveRun to abort an in-flight run. The fix routes these commands through the same isStreaming || streamMessageIdRef.current || isChainInProgressRef.current guard and falls back to addToQueue() when the agent is busy. The diff preview shows the accompanying test coverage in router-steering.test.ts asserting queued delivery for both input-mode submits and inline-arg invocations.

1368:v2:8380c1413f88.title: Fix(cli): delete a word with Ctrl+Backspace
1368:v2:8380c1413f88.summary: The PR updates the multiline input handler in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` to treat Ctrl+Backspace as a word-delete shortcut alongside the existing Alt+Backspace and Ctrl+W bindings, matching common terminal editing expectations. It also adds a test in `cli/src/components/__tests__/multiline-input.test.tsx` that mounts the component and verifies pressing Ctrl+Backspace on `hello world` removes the trailing word, leaving `hello ` with the cursor at position 6.

1346:v2:f90c9a472d66.title: Add -c/--continue alias and nothing to continue notice
1346:v2:f90c9a472d66.summary: The CLI adds a short -c alias alongside the existing --continue flag for resuming sessions, parsed in parseArgs and threaded through app.tsx as continueRequested. When the probe finds no active session with status 'none', the landing screen renders a FreebuffNothingToContinueNotice explaining there's nothing to continue. Tests in cli-args.test.ts and freebuff-nothing-to-continue.test.tsx pin the parsing behavior and the status-gated notice invariant.

1372:v2:08c03a688174.title: Add agent plugin install and discovery (Agent Plugins spec v1.0.0)
1372:v2:08c03a688174.summary: The PR adds a `freebuff plugin install <url>` command that fetches a GitHub tarball, validates its manifest against the 1.0.0 schema, and writes the plugin under the plugins root (`FREEBUFF_PLUGINS_ROOT` or `~/.agents/plugins`). It also wires discovered plugin skills and MCP servers into the session registries via new `plugin-discovery` helpers, with name-conflict checks against the user's existing roots.

1259:v2:6e049813395f.title: Fix MCP tool schema and result handling bugs
1259:v2:6e049813395f.summary: The PR overhauls how MCP tool schemas and results are stored and mapped, fixing sessions that died from cyclic Zod instances in serialized state and tool results that poisoned prompt builds. It extracts content mapping into a dedicated module, stores schemas verbatim as plain JSON Schema, and repairs schema-guided decoding of string-encoded union parameters. New regression tests cover text/image/non-image resource mapping, loose MCP schema survival, zod-safe cloning, and non-image file part degradation.

1328:v2:c7628c5f8192.title: Reload MCP servers and skills after project change in picker
1328:v2:c7628c5f8192.summary: This PR updates the CLI so that when a developer switches projects through the project picker, the agent/MCP and skill registries are reinitialized for the newly selected project directory. Previously, `initializeAgentRegistry` and `initializeSkillRegistry` were not called after `setProjectRoot`, leaving cached local agents, MCP servers, and skills stale from the previous project and causing features like custom skills and MCP-based tools to fail to load. The fix clears the cached agent mode map and agents directory before reloading definitions, and adds an integration test reproducing the original bug and verifying correct reloads across project switches.

1308:v2:4c5239224ebf.title: Fix stuck model switches from false end-failure in session takeover
1308:v2:4c5239224ebf.summary: PR #1308 refactors the model_locked takeover path into runModelLockedTakeover with a new planModelLockedSwitch helper that distinguishes a real release from a lock that already released itself, so the "ending it failed" notice only fires after a genuine delete was attempted. The change adds full test coverage in model-locked-takeover.test.ts and freebuff-session-api.test.ts, and introduces a consume-once explicit-pick marker to bound retries to a single round.

1316:v2:8b479e8ef64f.title: Stop the CLI launcher from re-downloading an installed binary on every launch
1316:v2:8b479e8ef64f.summary: The launcher now skips re-downloading the platform binary when it already exists on disk, even if the `freebuff-metadata.json` cache is missing or corrupt. A new `getUpdateComparisonVersion` helper falls back to the wrapper version when the cached version is null, so genuine updates still proceed while lost-cache launches stop triggering a full release transfer. The registry URL is now overridable via `CODEBUFF_NPM_REGISTRY_URL`, mirroring the existing app URL escape hatch for tests.

1302:v2:b9eff978cd65.title: Expand response assertion test coverage
1302:v2:b9eff978cd65.summary: Adds test cases to the assertion suite in common/src/util/__tests__/axiom-complete-response.test.ts covering complete responses, statusless cases, and non-object inputs. Tightens the existing partial response assertion with anchored error regex. This broadens coverage of the Axiom response guard used by operator-facing telemetry integrations

1292:v2:061f63efbf47.title: Drop orphaned tool results at trim boundary
1292:v2:061f63efbf47.summary: Adds a post-trim pass to trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit that removes tool messages whose matching assistant tool-call was cut at the token-limit boundary, preventing providers from rejecting the result with a missing tool_call_id error. It compares tool-call ids present in the input against those surviving the trim and drops only the orphaned results, leaving any pre-existing malformations untouched.

1274:v2:df08f0d72238.title: Feat(cli): scroll the transcript three lines per wheel notch
1274:v2:df08f0d72238.summary: The PR proposes adding a `wheelScrollAcceleration` utility to the CLI's chat transcript scrollbox, replacing OpenTUI's default single-line scroll with a flat three lines per wheel notch. It introduces a `ConstantScrollAccel` class that returns a fixed multiplier of 3, ignoring scroll velocity unlike `MacOSScrollAccel`, and includes unit and integration tests verifying the behavior. The change addresses user feedback that the transcript scrolls too slowly, matching terminal and desktop app conventions.

1258:v2:c5e74a5f9efe.title: Wait for current turn to finish before auto-update restart
1258:v2:c5e74a5f9efe.summary: The npm-wrapper launcher now polls a per-pid run-activity marker file written by the CLI while an agent turn is in progress, deferring `stopRunningProcess` for the auto-update restart until that marker clears (bounded by `RUN_IDLE_MAX_WAIT_MS`). A new `startRunActivityMarker` subscribes to `isChainInProgress` transitions in `chat-store` and creates/removes the `codebuff-run-active-${pid}` file accordingly, while `spawnInstalledBinary` clears any stale marker left by a process that died before its own exit handler ran. Tests cover immediate resolution when idle, bounded waiting on an active turn, stale-marker cleanup, and ordering of staging, waiting, and stopping.

1256:v2:e0c40e49f4a5.title: Queue /plan, /interview, /review mid-turn instead of interrupting
1256:v2:e0c40e49f4a5.summary: The PR routes /plan, /interview, and /review submissions (and their inline-argument forms) through a new sendOrQueuePrompt helper in command-registry.ts, so that when a run is already in progress the input is appended to the pending queue rather than firing a second sendMessage that would register a competing active-run owner. It also introduces capturePendingAttachments and clears pending attachments in the test setup/teardown, ensuring staged attachments follow the prompt they were staged for whether the send is immediate or queued.

1265:v2:14bc15498869.title: Register compact command in slash commands palette and registry
1265:v2:14bc15498869.summary: The PR adds a new `compact` slash command (with `summarize` alias) to the `cli` that surfaces in the slash commands palette via `slash-commands.ts` and is registered in `command-registry.ts` with a handler in `compact.ts`. The command compacts and summarizes conversation history, bailing early if the conversation is empty, queuing the command if a stream or chain is active, and dispatching `/compact` to the agent runtime otherwise. A new test suite in `compact-command.test.ts` covers early bail, idle dispatch, and queueing behavior.

1270:v2:35e1f28fa310.title: Fix NaN/Infinity handling in ad display count
1270:v2:35e1f28fa310.summary: The PR updates `responseAdDisplayCount` in `common/src/util/lazy-response-ads.ts` to guard against non-finite inputs by substituting them with zero before applying `Math.max` and `Math.floor`. It adds a new test file covering clamping behavior for NaN, Infinity, and negative inputs, plus flooring of fractional values.

1284:v2:f3da456b874b.title: Fix NaN handling in ttft bucket index
1284:v2:f3da456b874b.summary: The PR corrects the ttft bucket index calculation so that NaN ttft values default to bucket 0 instead of propagating as NaN, while leaving the existing clamping behavior for Infinity unchanged. A corresponding test case is added to lock in the NaN-to-0 routing and verify that positive Infinity still clamps to the top bucket and negative Infinity lands in bucket 0.

1261:v2:04ed29339961.title: Clamp negative streaks to zero before computing tier bonuses
1261:v2:04ed29339961.summary: The getFreebuffStreakGlmWeeklyUnits function now applies Math.max(0, streak) before dividing by FREEBUFF_STREAK_REWARD_INTERVAL_DAYS, so corrupted or malformed negative streak data yields zero bonus units instead of negative tiers. A new test case confirms negative inputs return zero while zero and positive values remain unchanged.

1260:v2:2933738e5296.title: Optimize streak calculation to single-pass iteration
1260:v2:2933738e5296.summary: The PR rewrites the streak calculation function in freebuff-streak.ts to replace the separate filter and reduce passes with a single for...of loop that builds the usageDateSet and tracks lastUsageDate together. This collapses two traversals of usageDates into one, trimming the diff to nine additions and seven removals while preserving the existing streak math. The change is a pure refactor with no behavioral impact.

1253:v2:fddbffabeff1.title: Guard non-finite input in usage summary window calculation
1253:v2:fddbffabeff1.summary: The `buildFreebuffUsageSummary` function now checks that `params.windowDays` is finite before falling back to `FREEBUFF_USAGE_MAP_DAYS`. A `NaN` or `Infinity` value previously flowed into `Math.max(1, ...)`, producing a misleading usage window and an invalid date-keyed set. This adds an explicit finite check so malformed input resolves to the default map days.

1250:v2:8e7fa6b1d1ac.title: Fix size validation in sample size with seed
1250:v2:8e7fa6b1d1ac.summary: The random sampling utility in common util random ts now clamps the size argument to a non-negative finite integer via safeSize before slicing the shuffled array. Previously a non-finite or negative size could produce a slice that returned the full array or threw. The change routes the validated safeSize into result slice instead of the raw size.

1248:v2:5c53c82e5f26.title: Fix NaN handling in streak display function
1248:v2:5c53c82e5f26.summary: The PR guards against non-finite `streak` values in `getFreebuffStreakLine` by substituting a `safeStreak` of 0 when `Number.isFinite(streak)` returns false. The sanitized value flows through the existing `filled`/`beyond`/`label` calculations so a NaN streak no longer corrupts the rendered streak row or produces invalid labels. It touches only `common/src/util/freebuff-streak-line.ts`.

1179:v2:c2d62ac12492.title: Reload MCP config after project selection
1179:v2:c2d62ac12492.summary: The PR adds an activateProject helper in cli/src/utils/project-picker.ts that switches the working directory, updates the project root, and reloads the local agent registry so .agents definitions and mcp.json servers are picked up from the newly selected project. The project picker callback in cli/src/index.tsx now calls activateProject instead of doing process.chdir plus setProjectRoot inline, and passes reloadAgentRegistry set to the inverse of hasAgentOverride so an explicit --agent override still preserves the caller-provided registry. A reloadLocalAgentRegistry function is introduced in cli/src/utils/local-agent-registry.ts to clear the cached agent lists and directory before reinitializing.

1244:v2:fce85fb59a75.title: Tighten date validation to reject Infinity values
1244:v2:fce85fb59a75.summary: The daysBetween function in reddit-freebuff-retention.ts now uses Number.isFinite instead of Number.isNaN to validate date inputs. This change correctly rejects Infinity values that would otherwise pass through the previous NaN-only check, ensuring invalid date ranges throw an error instead of producing incorrect calculations.

1291:v2:1cf063f16e1e.title: Guard whitespace-only old strings against empty-match corruption
1291:v2:1cf063f16e1e.summary: The PR adds a guard in `tryMatchOldStr` so that an `oldString` composed entirely of whitespace is reported as not-found rather than collapsing to an empty search string that vacuously matches at position zero.

1243:v2:bf9573334ab6.title: Fix NaN handling in ad slot selection
1243:v2:bf9573334ab6.summary: The `getResponseAdForSlot` function in `common/src/util/lazy-response-ads.ts` now validates `slotIndex` with `Number.isFinite()`, defaulting to 0 when the value is NaN or Infinity. Previously, a NaN `slotIndex` would propagate through `Math.floor`, `Math.max`, and the modulo operation, yielding NaN and returning an undefined ad. This change ensures robust ad slot selection under invalid inputs.

1242:v2:ed30d75523d2.title: Fix NaN handling in file read offset and limit
1242:v2:ed30d75523d2.summary: The PR adds Number.isFinite() checks in the windowFileRead function within common/src/util/file-read-limits.ts. Previously, NaN or Infinity values for offset and limit could propagate through Math.floor and Math.max, producing unintended NaN results. The fix defaults to safe values when the inputs are invalid.

1241:v2:ff7d6ee8a357.title: Fix NaN handling in plan units formatting
1241:v2:ff7d6ee8a357.summary: The plan units formatter returns the string 'NaN' when the units argument is NaN or Infinity because it lacks a finite-number guard. The PR adds a `Number.isFinite()` check at the start of the function in `common/src/util/freebuff-plan-summary.ts` to return '0' for invalid inputs before the rounding logic runs. No existing tests cover this function.

1240:v2:466b38676f37.title: Fix NaN handling in pct function in db-health-alerts
1240:v2:466b38676f37.summary: The pct function in common/src/util/db-health-alerts.ts now validates that part and whole are finite numbers using Number.isFinite() before performing the percentage calculation. Previously, NaN or Infinity inputs would propagate as NaN through Math.round((part / whole) * 100), potentially causing incorrect alert evaluation. The fix returns 0 for any invalid or non-positive inputs, ensuring the evaluateStatCoverage function produces reliable results even with malformed database health data.

1238:v2:3290d6ed9dab.title: Fix NaN handling in ttft bucket index
1238:v2:3290d6ed9dab.summary: The PR proposes adding a Number.isFinite() check in the ttftBucketIndex function in common/src/util/ttft-histogram.ts, defaulting invalid inputs like NaN or Infinity to 0 to prevent the calculation from producing NaN values. This avoids a chain of NaN propagation through Math.max and Math.log. The change touches only the common package, an approved contribution area.

1235:v2:3346a2c810c0.title: Replace global NaN check with safer alternative in XML parser
1235:v2:3346a2c810c0.summary: This PR updates the `parseEntities` function in `common/src/util/saxy.ts` to use `Number.isNaN` instead of the global `isNaN`, avoiding unwanted type coercion when validating parsed numeric entity values. The change improves type safety in the XML entity parsing logic.

1236:v2:5907c053ea71.title: Improve type safety in dates utility number check
1236:v2:5907c053ea71.summary: This pull request updates the `formatTimeUntil` function in `common/src/util/dates.ts` to replace the global `isNaN` function with `Number.isNaN`, avoiding implicit type coercion that can produce unexpected results when validating the computed time difference value. The change improves type safety and predictability in time formatting logic without altering the overall behavior for valid inputs.

1222:v2:b1e6ce90764a.title: Add shallow equality guards to MessageBlockStore
1222:v2:b1e6ce90764a.summary: The PR adds shallow equality guards to `setContext` and `setCallbacks` in the MessageBlockStore to prevent unnecessary re-renders caused by Zustand notifying subscribers with new object references even when values are identical. It also exports a shared `EMPTY_RESPONSE_ADS` constant to maintain stable object reference identity when ads are disabled, and adds a unit test suite verifying that subscribers fire only on true mutations and are suppressed on identical updates.

1226:v2:4c4af0a0bd89.title: Bound file matches in suggestion engine, cut fuzzy allocations
1226:v2:4c4af0a0bd89.summary: The PR caps file suggestion results to the top 100 ranked matches in `filterFileMatches`, preventing memory spikes and keystroke lag when typing `@` mentions in large projects. It rewrites `createHighlightIndices` to populate index arrays in a single direct loop, and swaps `indices.filter(...).length` in `fuzzyMatch` for an in-place counter loop to avoid throwaway array allocations.

1223:v2:f087c20d011f.title: Fast bailout for indentation retry in diff matching
1223:v2:f087c20d011f.summary: The PR refactors `tryToDoStringReplacementWithExtraIndentation` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/generate-diffs-prompt.ts` to pre-split `searchContent` into `searchLines` once and bail out early when the first indented line is absent from `oldFileContent`, avoiding up to 18 redundant split/map/join cycles. On a 50-line benchmark the failed-indentation recovery path drops from 96.10 ms to 6.49 ms (14.8x faster).

1217:v2:09876e06a681.title: Eliminate redundant stat calls and queue shifts in file tree crawl
1217:v2:09876e06a681.summary: This PR reorders the directory traversal in `project-file-tree.ts` so that `fs.readdir` runs before `parseGitignore`, calling `parseGitignore` only when an ignore file appears in the returned entries. It also swaps `queue.shift()!` for an index pointer to avoid quadratic array reallocations and passes existing directory entries into `parseGitignoreWithMode` to skip unnecessary stat calls.

1219:v2:49438e90c74a.title: Optimize think tag parser with early-exit and cursor indexing
1219:v2:49438e90c74a.summary: The PR refactors the think-tag detection logic in `cli/src/utils/think-tag-parser.ts` to replace sequential prefix array checks with an early-exit `lastIndexOf` approach and switches `parseThinkTags` from repeated string slicing to index cursor traversal, reducing allocations. The unused `PARTIAL_OPEN_PREFIXES` and `PARTIAL_CLOSE_PREFIXES` arrays are removed, and all 22 existing unit tests pass with identical behavior.

1218:v2:580edcff23fc.title: Conditionally compute visual line layout in Thinking component
1218:v2:580edcff23fc.summary: In `cli/src/components/thinking.tsx`, the `getLastNVisualLines` wrapping computation now runs only when `thinkingCollapseState` is `'preview'`, skipping the expensive measure-and-wrap pass for both `'hidden'` and `'expanded'` states. In `cli/src/components/blocks/thinking-block.tsx`, a fast-path avoids allocating intermediate `.map()` arrays when `blocks.length === 1` during streaming updates. The PR adds unit tests covering all three collapse states and reports 5x speedups on hidden state and 4.3x on expanded state in end-to-end React render benchmarks.

1215:v2:5b5ebb50e8b6.title: Optimize value extraction with early guard and streaming scan
1215:v2:5b5ebb50e8b6.summary: This PR refactors the value extraction helper in the CLI utilities to avoid allocating a full array of lines on every call by replacing the split operation with an index-based line scanner that walks the output incrementally. An instant substring guard checks for the presence of the searched key before any parsing begins, and keys located near the start of the output now return immediately without scanning the remainder. Benchmarks show lookups for missing keys in a 5,000-line output dropping from 11.02ms down to 0.20ms (55x speedup), and finding a key on line 1 dropping from 17.41ms down to 0.31ms (56x speedup across 100 runs).

1212:v2:8ce7a100f5d7.title: Support Windows paths and directory separators in path tab completion
1212:v2:8ce7a100f5d7.summary: The PR refactors path tab completion in the CLI to recognize Windows drive paths (C:\...) and UNC paths as absolute by exporting an isAbsolutePath helper that checks both POSIX and Windows path styles. It also exports isCompleteDirectory to detect trailing backslashes appended by path-completion.ts, and toRelativePath to convert absolute completions back to relative display paths, restoring automatic directory navigation on Windows.

1208:v2:b302df72779e.title: Auto-save launched project to recent projects and canonicalize paths
1208:v2:b302df72779e.summary: This PR proposes automatically recording a launched project into recent-projects.json during CLI boot in cli/src/index.tsx whenever Freebuff starts directly inside a project rather than showing the project picker, filling the gap left by saveRecentProject previously being called only on project-picker selection. It canonicalizes projectPath with path.resolve() in saveRecentProject and removeRecentProject within cli/src/utils/recent-projects.ts to prevent duplicate entries and filtering mismatches from relative paths or trailing slashes, and switches the import of getConfigDir from ./auth to ./config-dir to avoid loading the full auth/api stack. New tests in cli/src/__tests__/utils/recent-projects.test.ts cover path canonicalization, disk-validation filtering, LRU-style capping at MAX_RECENT_PROJECTS, project removal, and clearing behavior.

1206:v2:e139a3509eac.title: Support quoted image paths and preserve prompt in CLI image command
1206:v2:e139a3509eac.summary: This PR refactors the `/image <path> [message]` command parsing to correctly handle quoted paths (`"..."` and `'...'`) and backslash-escaped spaces by extracting the logic into a standalone pure utility `parseImageCommandArgs`. Previously, naive whitespace splitting corrupted filenames containing spaces and discarded the accompanying user message. 1198:v2:d58ff5f2e291.title: Sdk: use max instead of sum for OpenRouter cost fields

1177:v2:13bb17fd2e39.title: Synchronize terminal cursor with input caret for CJK IME support

1176:v2:afaa31defbf1.title: Never wipe chat history on compaction
1176:v2:afaa31defbf1.summary: The compaction path now only replaces history when a real summary is produced, keeping existing turns on empty or think-only responses and logging a warning. 1174:v2:825474ddcee2.title: Recover mid-stream 5xx/429 like severed connections

1175:v2:7d3ddfdc5da9.title: Fix(sdk): take max of OpenRouter cost and upstream inference cost
1175:v2:7d3ddfdc5da9.summary: The PR switches all three cost-reporting sites in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` (streaming `reportCost`, `generateText`, and structured paths) to take the max of `usage.cost` and `cost_details.upstream_inference_cost` instead of summing them, preventing double-counted credits on normal OpenRouter routes and correctly handling BYOK routes where cost is zero. The provided text is validated, cached for the process lifetime, and rendered into native knowledge-aware agent prompts without altering default rules or tools. Existing history rejects instruction changes before inference to prevent retrofitting.

1506:v2:1386c91495be.title: Add CLI flags for user-controlled shell and filesystem restrictions
1506:v2:1386c91495be.summary: The change introduces four new flags, `--no-shell`, `--ask-shell`, `--project-only`, and `--read-only`, which configure a new per-run execution policy within the SDK. This policy enforces restrictions on tool dispatch and filesystem adapters, specifically classifying external tools and preventing symlink escapes. A correlation bridge is added to manage serialized approval requests for shell commands when the interactive flag is active.

1506:v2:387787ed0613.title: Runtime enforcement for shell and file access permissions
1506:v2:387787ed0613.summary: This change introduces a new execution policy module in the SDK that classifies tool capabilities and enforces permission boundaries before dispatch. It adds four CLI flags, including read-only mode and project-only confinement, to control shell and filesystem access without relying on model instructions. A correlated bridge in the common package serializes human approval requests for shell commands to prevent race conditions in concurrent runs.

1346:v2:ef0227105423.title: CLI short flag for session resume and empty result notice
1346:v2:ef0227105423.summary: This PR adds a `-c` short alias to the existing `--continue` option in the CLI argument parser and threads the raw flag through the application state. When the flag is set but the session probe finds no active seat to resume, the chat view renders a new notice explaining that there is nothing to continue and prompts the user to start a new session.

1346:v2:f1a4e2eee067.title: Add short continue flag and no-session notice
1346:v2:f1a4e2eee067.summary: The CLI parser gains a `-c` shorthand alongside `--continue`, and the app state threads that launch-time flag separately from history-based resume so a notice can distinguish a real request to pick up a live session from merely picking a past chat. A new self-gating notice renders when that request was made but the session probe returns no active session, instead of silently starting fresh. Tests cover argument parsing and the render gating invariant.

1518:v2:7d9fa0a84089.title: Harden release URL and redirect validation
1518:v2:7d9fa0a84089.summary: This PR tightens release download validation by rejecting URL overrides that include a path or nonstandard port on public release hosts, while preserving custom ports for loopback local development servers. It also updates redirect handling to refuse targets containing URL credentials or changing the original port, ensuring requests remain on the intended origin.

1519:v2:3378f9de4b37.title: Prevent follow-up cards from interrupting Freebuff base2 runs
1519:v2:3378f9de4b37.summary: The PR modifies the base2 agent factory to default the noFollowups flag to true when the mode is set to free. This ensures that free-mode roots omit the suggest_followups tool by default, aligning their behavior with the existing Fable variant. The change preserves the ask_user tool for clarifying questions and allows explicit overrides to re-enable follow-up cards.

1520:v2:64014193f61e.title: Align shared JSON types with readonly values
1520:v2:64014193f61e.summary: The PR proposes aligning the shared JSON value and array types with the AI SDK by applying readonly constraints to prevent TypeScript errors during SDK declaration bundling. It includes a regression test to verify compatibility between tool model message provider options and the shared metadata type.

1519:v2:36b1f59486b7.title: Prevent optional follow-ups from pausing free runs
1519:v2:36b1f59486b7.summary: The PR disables the optional follow-up tool by default for Freebuff base2 roots while keeping the ability to ask clarifying questions. It preserves the feature for other agent modes and allows explicit opt-in for Freebuff variants, with tests covering the default behavior and the override.

1520:v2:a166709d7dd4.title: Align shared JSON types with AI SDK readonly values
1520:v2:a166709d7dd4.summary: The PR proposes updating the shared JSON type definitions in `common/src/types/json.ts` to use readonly modifiers for objects and arrays. This change aims to match the structure of the AI SDK's provider options and resolve current TypeScript declaration bundling errors in the CI pipeline. A new regression test is included to verify that the local provider metadata types remain compatible with the external tool model message definitions.

1518:v2:c99b071d4f12.title: Harden release download and redirect checks
1518:v2:c99b071d4f12.summary: The proposal tightens validation of release download origins to reject overrides containing a path or a nonstandard port on public release hosts, while still allowing custom ports for loopback addresses used in local development. It also refuses redirects that include URL credentials or change the original port. Regression tests are added to cover these malformed origin and unsafe redirect scenarios.

1316:v2:872334be3b7e.title: Prevent redundant binary downloads when launcher metadata is missing
1316:v2:872334be3b7e.summary: This change stops the launcher from re-downloading the platform binary on every launch when the metadata cache file is missing or unreadable. It checks for the installed binary's presence and falls back to the wrapper version to determine if an update is truly required, preventing unnecessary downloads and startup failures when the release host is unreachable.

1372:v2:d889da564e3a.title: Agent plugin support with install command and session integration
1372:v2:d889da564e3a.summary: This PR implements the Agent Plugins specification v1.0.0 by adding a new CLI install command that fetches plugin tarballs from GitHub URLs and verifies their manifest, skills, and server configurations. It integrates plugin assets into the skill and MCP registries so installed components join the active session after a restart. The change includes a new domain model for plugins in the common package and a command-line interface for users to add these bundles.

1531:v2:914f8e4120dc.title: Adds execution permission flags and shell approval queue to the CLI
1531:v2:914f8e4120dc.summary: This change integrates new execution permission controls into the CLI, allowing users to restrict shell commands and filesystem access via flags like `--no-shell` and `--read-only`. It introduces a serialized, correlated approval bridge that handles concurrent shell requests by queuing them and denying timeouts or aborts to prevent unsafe implicit approvals. The SDK now exposes a per-run execution policy that enforces these restrictions, blocks external tools unless explicitly trusted, and guards filesystem operations against symlink escapes.

1530:v2:4ab471d88acf.title: SDK permission model and apply patch target validation
1530:v2:4ab471d88acf.summary: The PR introduces an execution policy module for the SDK that classifies tool capabilities and enforces restrictions such as read-only, project-only, and shell-approval constraints during runtime. It specifically adds validation for `apply_patch` targets to resolve nested file paths against the project root, rejecting operations that escape the designated sandbox. These changes include comprehensive regression tests verifying that subagents and external tool dispatches correctly inherit these authorization boundaries.

1506:v2:590efa64fdf1.title: Add per-run execution permissions to the SDK for shell and file access
1506:v2:590efa64fdf1.summary: This change adds an immutable execution policy to each SDK run that classifies tool capabilities and guards filesystem adapter reads and writes with path-containment and symlink-aware checks. It denies external tools and shell execution when read-only or project-only restrictions are active unless the host explicitly trusts external capabilities. The policy is captured in the tool-dispatch closure so spawned and nested agents inherit the parent's security boundaries without process-global state.

1531:v2:d190d1e5d288.title: Add execution permission flags and shell approval queue to CLI and SDK
1531:v2:d190d1e5d288.summary: The PR wires `--no-shell`, `--ask-shell`, `--project-only`, and `--read-only` flags from the CLI into the SDK's execution policy model, which enforces filesystem and shell restrictions on a per-run basis. It introduces a new serialized shell-approval bridge that tracks concurrent commands in FIFO order, resolving requests as denied on timeout, abort, or UI shutdown to prevent unsafe grants. The changes also gate external tool dispatch and symlink-aware path containment checks under these new restrictions.

1530:v2:5246f6f2f5e7.title: SDK validates nested patch paths against project root
1530:v2:5246f6f2f5e7.summary: This change proposes a per-run execution policy in the public SDK that resolves the nested target of an apply_patch call against the project root before dispatch. It ensures that outside-project targets are rejected and that subagents inherit the same policy constraints.

1506:v2:d1cc2e3830fe.title: Add per-run execution permissions to the SDK
1506:v2:d1cc2e3830fe.summary: This PR introduces an immutable execution policy that each SDK run captures to authorize tool calls and guard filesystem reads and writes. It proposes new flags such as `noShell`, `askShell`, `projectOnly`, and `readOnly`, while classifying built-in tools and failing closed for unknown or external tools. The change also implements symlink-aware path containment checks and ensures spawned subagents inherit the parent run's policy callback.

1531:v2:743ed8dd4287.title: Wire execution permission controls and shell approval queue
1531:v2:743ed8dd4287.summary: This change adds four CLI flags that map to an SDK execution policy, gating shell, filesystem, and external tool calls with deny-by-default logic. A new correlated bridge serializes concurrent shell approval requests and guarantees a denial on timeout, abort, or shutdown so a stale UI answer can never approve a different command.

1530:v2:a619093393f7.title: SDK execution policy validates nested patch target paths
1530:v2:a619093393f7.summary: The proposed change introduces an immutable per-run execution policy in the SDK that classifies every built-in tool by capability and resolves the nested target of an apply_patch operation before dispatch. Under projectOnly confinement, that target is canonicalized with a symlink-aware path check so in-project paths are allowed and outside-project or symlink-escape paths are rejected prior to any write override execution.

1372:v2:203bd3d21da5.title: Add support for installing and loading agent plugin bundles
1372:v2:203bd3d21da5.summary: The PR proposes a new plugin install command that downloads agent plugin bundles conforming to the Agent Plugins specification. It adds domain logic in `common/` to validate manifests, load skills and MCP server configurations, and map them to the client's internal formats. The CLI integrates these loaded components into the existing skill and agent registries so they become active after a session restart.

1394:v2:3d0d3c5bfc24.title: Fix filename-only code search results in SDK
1394:v2:3d0d3c5bfc24.summary: The PR updates the SDK's `code-search` tool to correctly parse ripgrep output when filename-only flags like `--files-with-matches` are present. It adds helper logic to detect these flags, adjusts the subprocess arguments to include `--null`, and modifies the stdout parsing to handle NUL-delimited paths and non-UTF-8 filenames via base64 encoding.

1546:v2:a086d9fd612f.title: Block URL tool when network proxy is active
1546:v2:a086d9fd612f.summary: The update changes the web URL tooling in the SDK so that it refuses to operate when system proxy environment variables are set. Instead of falling back to the global fetch function, which bypasses the secure DNS pinning checks and creates a security vulnerability, the tool now explicitly throws an error. This ensures that the destination server cannot be spoofed by a malicious proxy resolving hostnames to private or internal addresses.

1545:v2:20a1cc0f8d48.title: Sponsored refusal walk fails closed on inline code and variable
1545:v2:20a1cc0f8d48.summary: The sponsored refusal walk now returns unverifiable for interpreter inline code flags like `node -e` and `python -c`, which previously passed unread. It also fails closed when the command word is built from a shell variable, preventing a refused command from executing behind an unreadable word.

1346:v2:f234b3135e52.title: Add continue flag alias and no session notice in CLI
1346:v2:f234b3135e52.summary: The PR proposes adding the -c alias to the --continue command in the CLI argument parser and threading a distinct launch-time flag into the app component. It introduces a new notice component that displays when a user requests to continue but the session probe finds no active seat to resume.

1427:v2:f56dde57bf12.title: Propose self-hosted Telegram bridge for SDK agent chats
1427:v2:f56dde57bf12.summary: This PR adds a new example file in the SDK package that implements a self-hosted Telegram bot bridge to forward chat messages to agent runs. It supports per-chat session continuity, includes a command to reset context, and uses a plain fetch-based long-polling loop with exponential backoff for transient API errors. The change requires no new external dependencies and documents the setup in the SDK readme and changelog.

1545:v2:c8068a3aa364.title: Refuse variable commands and inline interpreter code
1545:v2:c8068a3aa364.summary: The PR proposes failing closed on command words built from shell variables or substitutions in the sponsored refusal walk. It also classifies interpreter inline code flags, such as the short forms of `node --eval` and `python --command`, as unverifiable instead of passing them through. The change adds tests to confirm these bypass spellings are now refused while script files and judged modules remain allowed.

1546:v2:e693e344e887.title: Refuse url fetch when proxy is active
1546:v2:e693e344e887.summary: This change prevents a security bypass in the `read_url` tool where the system would fall back to global fetch when running under Bun with proxy variables configured. Instead of dropping DNS pinning and risking server-side request forgery, the transport now refuses the request and returns a clear error explaining why the destination cannot be validated. A new test case confirms that the tool rejects requests when proxy environment variables are present.

1551:v2:448552d9dfde.title: Fix stale React props corrupting text during IME batched input
1551:v2:448552d9dfde.summary: This PR refactors eight keyboard and mouse handlers in the CLI's multiline input component to read state from synchronous refs instead of React props. This change ensures that when input methods compose multiple events in a single batch, each handler sees the latest text and cursor position without stale data. New unit tests verify correct behavior for Vietnamese IME compose-and-replace scenarios where backspace and accent insertion occur together.

1551:v2:ec95e06ab72e.title: Fix stale React props corrupting IME input in multiline editor
1551:v2:ec95e06ab72e.summary: The PR proposes switching all keyboard and mouse handlers in the `MultilineInput` component to read from synchronous refs instead of React props. This ensures that batched Input Method Editor events, such as those from Vietnamese IMEs, see the latest state updates. The changes are complemented by new tests that verify correct behavior during complex character replacement sequences.

1551:v2:005aa857d519.title: Multiline input now uses synchronous refs for batched key events
1551:v2:005aa857d519.summary: This PR updates the remaining keyboard handlers in MultilineInput to read text and cursor state from synchronous refs instead of potentially stale React props, and to write those refs before calling onChange. The change extends the ref-based pattern already applied to text insertion so that deletion, navigation, cursor movement, and mouse interactions remain correct when multiple key events arrive within a single React batch.

1551:v2:9f113d58cad2.title: Fix text corruption during batched keyboard input
1551:v2:9f113d58cad2.summary: This change updates all keyboard handlers in the `MultilineInput` component to read state from synchronous refs instead of React props and to update those refs before calling `onChange`. It resolves text corruption that occurs when multiple key events fire in a single batch, such as with Vietnamese Telex IMEs, where stale props cause backspace to delete from an outdated string snapshot. The associated tests simulate these batched input scenarios to verify that ref-based reads prevent the corruption.

1551:v2:558f3e4b713d.title: Fix stale props corrupting IME input in text field
1551:v2:558f3e4b713d.summary: This pull request modifies the multiline text input component so that all keyboard handlers read current values from internal references instead of outdated props. It also updates tests to drive rapid key sequences through real handlers to prevent text corruption during batched input events.

1553:v2:080dc3a76f3f.title: Skip plugin hook and vendor directories in local agent loader
1553:v2:080dc3a76f3f.summary: This update modifies the local agent loading functions to ignore `hooks/` and `vendor/` subdirectories inside `.agents`, preventing third-party plugin support scripts from being imported as executable modules. The change stops the CLI from crashing at startup when a plugin hook script calls `process.exit`, ensuring the user interface initializes correctly. Regression tests are included to verify that files in these skipped directories do not execute side effects during the discovery process.

1554:v2:8ba06aacf46a.title: Add foreground freebuff update command
1554:v2:8ba06aacf46a.summary: This PR introduces a new `update` command that triggers an immediate release installation in the foreground, bypassing the deferred update mechanism used during normal session exits. The npm launcher's `main` function now checks for this command before spawning the binary, allowing it to reuse the existing staging and atomic installation paths while ensuring no running process holds the replaced files. If the command is invoked directly on the binary without the npm wrapper, the CLI will exit and instruct the user to use npm instead.

1554:v2:ee3964bf05ab.title: Add foreground update command to install latest release immediately
1554:v2:ee3964bf05ab.summary: This PR adds a new update subcommand that triggers the launcher to fetch, verify, and install the latest binary before the main process starts. It updates the argument parser to recognize the new command and adds a fallback message in the binary entry point to guide users who bypassed the npm wrapper. The change also includes tests covering command detection, version comparison, and installation failure handling.

1553:v2:e950ef234188.title: Skip plugin hook and vendor directories in agent loader
1553:v2:e950ef234188.summary: This PR proposes adding `hooks/` and `vendor/` to the list of skipped subdirectories in `loadLocalAgents` and `listLocalAgentFiles`. This prevents the SDK from dynamically importing third-party plugin support scripts, such as `ponytail-subagent.js`, which previously executed top-level code and terminated the CLI on startup.

1554:v2:26377f4a4e23.title: Foreground update command for Freebuff
1554:v2:26377f4a4e23.summary: This PR proposes a new update command in the launcher that downloads and installs the latest release synchronously, reusing existing staging and atomic-install logic. It gates the command behind a new flag so that other wrapper binaries do not misinterpret prompt words as commands, and exits early in the main entry point if the command reaches the agent without the launcher.

1555:v2:d039c957c16a.title: Add a side question command for quick answers in the CLI
1555:v2:d039c957c16a.summary: This pull request introduces a new slash command that lets developers ask brief questions about the current session without adding them to the conversation history. The implementation creates a temporary agent instance with no tools and limits it to a single model call, then discards the resulting run state after rendering the answer inline.

1553:v2:427a807e04f7.title: Skip plugin hook and vendor directories during local agent loading
1553:v2:427a807e04f7.summary: The loader now excludes hooks/ and vendor/ directories under .agents so plugin support scripts are not imported as agent definitions, preventing startup failures caused by executable side effects. Documentation and changelogs were updated to mark these directory names as reserved, and regression tests verify that support files are skipped while valid agents remain loadable.

1555:v2:5e2f44ac1d2c.title: Add inline side question command for the terminal interface
1555:v2:5e2f44ac1d2c.summary: This PR proposes a new /btw slash command that lets users ask a single-turn question about the current session without altering the conversation history. The implementation builds a tool-less agent using the selected model, runs one step via the SDK, and discards the resulting run state to keep the transcript unchanged.

1555:v2:d77ba9367e96.title: Add a /btw command to ask a side question without affecting
1555:v2:d77ba9367e96.summary: The pull request introduces a new slash command that sends a question to a single, tool-less agent built from the freebuff model catalog. The command passes the last settled run state to the agent, retrieves one answer, and discards the resulting state so the main conversation history remains unchanged.

1289:v2:efd00c783c66.title: Add skills panel command with browse, invoke, and delete features
1289:v2:efd00c783c66.summary: This PR introduces an interactive command that lets users manage loaded skills by browsing a list with search filtering, invoking a skill, opening its source file in an editor, or deleting it after confirmation. It updates the skill registry to support live reloading of external files and adds validation for new configuration fields in skill frontmatter to maintain compatibility with external definitions.

1286:v2:6cde9d6755d9.title: Add missing SCm loader preload
1286:v2:6cde9d6755d9.summary: This PR introduces a bun plugin that loads SCM files as strings to resolve import failures in CLI tests. It also adds a regression test to verify that tree-sitter query files load correctly.
